scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w server
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check -w client && npm run type-check -w server
scripts.build:sim: docker build -t portfolio-sim-build -f scripts/sim/Dockerfile . && docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/work" -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" portfolio-sim-build
scripts.build:models: blender -b scripts/blender/quadruped.blend --python scripts/blender/export_rigged_glb.py -- client/public/models/quadruped.glb && blender -b scripts/blender/yetibot.blend --python scripts/blender/export_rigged_glb.py -- client/public/models/yetibot.glb
